viewing_check: Look under the base and mount for a Jaguar stamp, part number, maker mark or 'Mascotte' / Desmo / Smiths marking; check thread or fixing stud (real mascots have radiator cap or bonnet stud). Check weight, casting seams and whether the metal is brass all through. Photograph the underside and mounting.
